# Background and Purpose

```{r get_trend}
# Helper to extract % proficient using cohortED function
get_percent_proficient <- function(data, grade, year, var = "ACHIEVEMENT_LEVEL", top_n = 3) {
  dat <- data[data$YEAR_NUM == year & !is.na(data[[var]]) & data$GRADE == grade, ]
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) return(NA)
  OUT <- make_proficiency_levels(dat, achievement = var, n_proficiencies = top_n, print_plot = FALSE)
  tbl <- OUT$Table
  as.numeric(gsub("%", "", tbl[1, "Proficient"]))
}

# Calculate proficiency rates
prev_prof <- round(get_percent_proficient(df, target_grade, previous_year,
                                          var = achieve_var, 
                                          top_n = n_proficiency_levels), 
                   1)
curr_prof <- round(get_percent_proficient(df, target_grade, current_year, 
                                          var = achieve_var, 
                                          top_n = n_proficiency_levels), 
                   1)
diff_prof <- round(curr_prof - prev_prof, 1)

# Calculate the advanced proficiency rates
prev_adv <- round(get_percent_proficient(df, target_grade, previous_year, 
                                         var = achieve_var, 
                                         top_n = n_advanced_levels),
                  1)
curr_adv <- round(get_percent_proficient(df, target_grade, current_year,
                                         var = achieve_var, 
                                         top_n = n_advanced_levels),
                  1)
diff_adv <- round(curr_adv - prev_adv, 1)

```

```{r phrase_trend}
# Phrase the trend
trend <- if (is.na(prev_prof) | is.na(curr_prof)) {
  "an **unknown change** in"
} else if (diff_prof > 0) {
  paste0("an **increase** of **", diff_prof, "** percentage points in")
} else if (diff_prof < 0) {
  paste0("a **decrease** of **", abs(diff_prof), "** percentage points in")
} else {
  "**no change** in"
}

# Phrase the advanced proficiency trend
adv_trend <- if (is.na(prev_adv) | is.na(curr_adv)) {
  "an **unknown change** in"
} else if (diff_adv > 0) {
  paste0("an **increase** of **", diff_adv, "** percentage points in")
} else if (diff_adv < 0) {
  paste0("a **decrease** of **", abs(diff_adv), "** percentage points in")
} else {
  "**no change** in"
}

# Add summary strings for both
trend_summary <- sprintf(
  "Proficiency changed from **%.1f%%** to **%.1f%%**",
  prev_prof, curr_prof
)

adv_summary <- sprintf(
  "Advanced proficiency changed from **%.1f%%** to **%.1f%%**",
  prev_adv, curr_adv
)

```

```{r intro_paragraph}
#| results: asis

intro_paragraph <- paste0(
  "State summative assessment results in **", subject_label, "** for **", grade_label, "** show ",
  trend, " overall proficiency rates and ", adv_trend, " advanced proficiency rates in **",
  to_academic_year(current_year), "** compared to **", to_academic_year(previous_year), "** ",
  sprintf("(Proficiency changed from **%.1f%%** to **%.1f%%**; Advanced proficiency changed from **%.1f%%** to **%.1f%%**).",
          prev_prof, curr_prof, prev_adv, curr_adv), " ",
  "This report uses a cohort-based, longitudinal lens to investigate these changes by tracking ",
  "student performance over time, assessing cohort persistence, and examining demographic and mobility patterns."
)

cat(intro_paragraph)

```

```{r cohort_paragraph}
#| results: asis

# Convert grade range to display string (e.g., "Grades 3 through 7")
grade_min <- min(grade_range)
grade_max <- max(grade_range)
grade_range_str <- if (grade_min == grade_max) {
  paste0("Grade ", grade_min)
} else {
  paste0("Grades ", grade_min, " through ", grade_max)
}


# Build paragraph
cohort_paragraph <- paste0(
  "Cohort-based analysis follows groups of students as they progress through grades over multiple years, ",
  "allowing us to distinguish between cohort effects and broader systemic trends. ",
  "This analysis includes students enrolled in **", grade_range_str, 
  "** during the academic years **", first_year_label, "** through **", current_year_label, "**. ",
  "The focus of this report is on **Grade ", target_grade, "** proficiency outcomes in **", current_year_label, "**. ",
  "For example, one cohort tracked in this report began in **Grade ", previous_grade, "** during **", previous_year_label, 
  "** and progressed to **Grade ", target_grade, "** in **", current_year_label, "**."
)

cat(cohort_paragraph)

```

```{r purpose_paragraph}
#| results: asis

# Purpose paragraph
purpose_paragraph <- paste0(
  "The goal of this report is to determine whether the observed change in **", subject_label, 
  "** proficiency in **", grade_label, "** is part of a larger cohort trend, ",
  "a shift in student composition, or a deviation from prior performance trajectories. ",
  "By comparing multiple cohorts who have passed through **", grade_label,
  "** in recent years, we aim to provide insight into whether the observed change is expected, ",
  "an anomaly, or a sign of a broader pattern that merits further attention."
)

cat(purpose_paragraph)

```
